name: Veranda High Resort Chiang Mai - MGallery Collection
short_description: A 71-room mountain-retreat resort near Hang Dong with rice-terrace views and a 4.7/5 ALL rating from around 800 reviews.
ai_summary: Veranda High Resort Chiang Mai is a 71-room boutique mountain retreat in the Hang Dong area outside central Chiang Mai, on the Mae Ping River basin, surrounded by mountains and rice and tea terraces. Its own Accor listing shows a 4.7/5 ALL guest rating from roughly 796 reviews. Facilities include a spa, fitness centre, infinity pool, two restaurants and a bar, and a library, with nearby attractions including Wat Phra That Doi Suthep.

faqs.question: Is Veranda High Resort Chiang Mai in the city centre?
faqs.answer: No -- it's in the Hang Dong area outside central Chiang Mai, positioned as a mountain retreat surrounded by rice and tea terraces rather than an Old City hotel. The 71-room boutique resort carries a 4.7/5 ALL guest rating from roughly 796 reviews and includes an infinity pool, spa, and library.
